name: BLE Gateway
summary: Bridges Bluetooth sensors into Signal K
description: Scans for Bluetooth Low Energy sensors — temperature, humidity, battery monitors — and forwards their readings to a Signal K server. Runs on several ESP32 variants.

boards.name: ESP32-C6 development board
boards.notes: The ESP32-C6-MINI-1U has no PCB antenna: without an external one the radio sees nothing, which looks exactly like a software fault.
